result: Added archive metadata safe-name/version validation, profile apply version enforcement, and durable interrupted-transaction detection that preserves the journal and blocks subsequent mutations instead of silently deleting it. Bulk archive promotion rollback remains coordinated for moved files and mod-list state, but true journal replay/SQLite rollback and endpoint-level role/CSRF/audit failure-injection tests remain incomplete.

evidence.outcome: metadata validation, profile version checks, durable journal guard, and bulk rollback changes

next_slice.summary: Implement true journal replay with persisted transaction manifests and SQLite rollback, plus focused endpoint role/CSRF/audit failure-injection tests.

blockers: Journal recovery preserves and blocks on interrupted transaction rather than replaying a manifest.
No endpoint-level role/CSRF/audit failure-injection tests added.
